review_scope: Primary read the full first-pass report and independently read the complete generator, browser JavaScript and controls.json. The first-pass reviewer read all other required files completely.
decision: Keep all four baseline labels and no configuration exceptions. Three-dimensional support, stair height, launcher normal and terminal alignment determine the route. Sustained movement advances on physics ticks in both interaction modes. Actuator choices must establish a traversable route before crossing it. The initial forward-facing view contains the relevant actuator markers, launcher orientation marks and terminal, with the interaction rules supplied by the visible rule card.

rationale_clarifications.temporal: The temporal evidence is held movement: the agent must regulate duration and release controls while position changes, including avoiding continued walking after landing. The automatic launch arc, during which new movement is blocked, is not by itself evidence of temporal understanding. No real-time classification is assigned by this capability audit.
rationale_clarifications.exploration_interface: Active viewing can count as exploration when needed to reveal task information. Here the needed route markers and launcher normals are rendered ahead of the initial camera; applying a known actuator and receiving its support-state update is execution, not by itself a prerequisite information-gathering probe.

uncertainties: Source-based capability judgments; no screenshot-only gameplay or empirical validation of profile boundaries.
